representation.name: Median Parsimony Informative Sites - Fungal
representation.description: Compute median percentage of parsimony informative sites across all MAFFT alignments in a ZIP archive
representation.shell_command:
set -eu

cat > /tmp/process_alignments.py << 'PYEOF'
import zipfile, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, statistics

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
percentages = []

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
        for name in zf.namelist():
            if name.endswith('.mafft'):
                zf.extract(name, tmpdir)
                fpath = os.path.join(tmpdir, name)
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', fpath],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
                )
                if result.returncode == 0:
                    parts = result.stdout.strip().split()
                    if len(parts) >= 3:
                        try:
                            pct = float(parts[2])
                            percentages.append(pct)
                        except ValueError:
                            pass

if not percentages:
    print('No alignments processed successfully', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

median_val = statistics.median(percentages)

with open('median_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'median_percentage\t{median_val}\n')
    f.write(f'n_alignments\t{len(percentages)}\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(percentages):
        f.write(f'{i+1}\t{p}\n')
PYEOF

python3 /tmp/process_alignments.py "$(inputs.input_zip.path)"

import requests, statistics

api_key = '[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]'
headers = {'x-api-key': api_key}
dataset_id = 'f9cad7b01a472135679a363234cf6360'
r = requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/datasets/{dataset_id}/display', headers=headers)

lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
values = []
for line in lines[1:]:  # skip header
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        values.append(float(parts[1]))

print(f'Number of values: {len(values)}')
print(f'Computed median: {statistics.median(values)}')
print(f'Min: {min(values)}, Max: {max(values)}')

import zipfile, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, statistics

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
percentages = []

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
        for name in zf.namelist():
            if name.endswith('.mafft'):
                zf.extract(name, tmpdir)
                fpath = os.path.join(tmpdir, name)
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', fpath],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
                )
                if result.returncode == 0:
                    parts = result.stdout.strip().split()
                    if len(parts) >= 3:
                        try:
                            pct = float(parts[2])
                            percentages.append(pct)
                        except ValueError:
                            pass

if not percentages:
    print('No alignments processed successfully', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

median_val = statistics.median(percentages)

with open('median_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'median_percentage\t{median_val}\n')
    f.write(f'n_alignments\t{len(percentages)}\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(percentages):
        f.write(f'{i+1}\t{p}\n')
PYEOF
